title: Rav Acha of Carthage

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bava Kamma 114b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.114b.23): when Rav Dimi came, he said that Rav Chana of Carthage — and some say Rav Acha of Carthage — related: “A case came before Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The linked passage gives Rav Chana and Rav Acha as alternative reporters. It also gives Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi and, in another version, Rabbi Yehudah HaNasi as the sage who heard the case. [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=337&lang=en) gives the same reporter alternatives.
